newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel finance minister to woo U.S. investors.
newsitem.headline: Israel finance minister to woo U.S. investors.

text.p: Finance Minister Dan Meridor left on Saturday for New York where he will stay until Thursday to participate in a conference on the Israeli economy sponsored by The Economist magazine, Treasury officials said on Sunday.
Meridor will talk about fiscal policy, economic reforms, budget cuts, privatisation and the geo-political situation and its effect on the economy.
The Israeli daily Yedioth Ahronoth said Meridor would try to persuade American businessmen to invest in Israel.
The conference will also deal with opportunities for foreign companies to develop products in Israel as well as opportunities in high-tech and research and development.
